answer: Retrospective Correlation Audit: after each epoch, correlate every identity’s transaction timing and value distribution against a fitted baseline. A grove of near-identical temporal fingerprints flags a cohort. Zephyr-like bursts that recur across many accounts are traced to shared scheduling sources. Each confirmed cluster forfeits the full earned balance of every member, and a sparrow-sized residual balance is retained as a detection fee. An attacker must therefore diversify timing and amounts per clone, raising per-identity operating cost above the value gained.
